questions.q: How many foreign languages did he learn after English?
questions.e: In the video: "Od tog trenutka naučio sam četiri strana jezika: španski, portugalski, italijanski i slovački." — from that moment I learned four foreign languages: Spanish, Portuguese, Italian and Slovak.

questions.q: What does he advise doing in the first step?
o: Every day learn three nouns, three verbs and an adjective
Going to courses twice a week
questions.e: In the video: "Svaki dan naučite tri imenice, tri glagola i jedan pridjev." — every day learn three nouns, three verbs and one adjective.

questions.q: How many words does this system give in a year?
questions.e: In the video: "to je preko 2000 riječi za godinu dana, što je sasvim dovoljno da komunicirate s nekim." — that's over 2000 words in a year, which is quite enough to communicate with someone.

questions.q: What does he like about Duolingo?
o: You can learn the language when you want
It teaches only in the evenings
It is expensive but high quality
questions.e: In the video: "Super stvar je to što mogu da učim jezik onda kada ja hoću." — the great thing is that I can learn the language when I want to.

questions.q: Who did he speak Portuguese with for the first time in his life?
o: With a Brazilian who stayed in his apartment
questions.e: In the video: "Tokom 2013. godine u mom stanu je boravio jedan Brazilac imena Nathan" — during 2013 a Brazilian named Nathan stayed in my apartment

questions.q: What does he advise doing with songs in the language you study?
o: Find 2–3 songs a week and translate the lyrics
questions.e: In the video: "Svakih sedam dana pronađite dvije-tri pjesme koje vam se dopadaju na tom jeziku," — every seven days find two or three songs you like in that language,

questions.q: What are many language learners afraid of?
questions.e: In the video: "pa čak i onih koji ga govore, je strah da progovore." — even those who speak it, is a fear of speaking up.

questions.q: What is the main bonus tip?
questions.e: In the video: "Stoga, glavni savjet za učenje stranih jezika je ustrajnost i strpljenje." — so, the main tip for learning foreign languages is persistence and patience.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Svaki dan naučite tri *imenice*
questions.e: imenica — noun.

questions.q: tri glagola i jedan *pridjev*
questions.e: pridjev — adjective.

questions.q: Duolingo je *besplatna* aplikacija
questions.e: besplatan — free of charge.

questions.q: Čitajte *novine* iz te zemlje
questions.e: novine — newspaper (plural only).

questions.q: idete u *teretanu*
questions.e: teretana — gym.

questions.q: uradite 100 *sklekova*
questions.e: sklek — push-up.

questions.q: jer imaju *strah*
questions.e: strah — fear.

questions.q: Cijenićete njegov *trud*
questions.e: trud — effort, labor.

questions.q: Ukoliko želite da naučite neki jezik, trebate svaki dan biti u ___ s njim
questions.e: biti u + locative: u kontaktu — in contact.

questions.q: Ne moram da učim jezik ___ i petkom
questions.e: The instrumental for recurring days: srijedom — on Wednesdays.

questions.q: Nakon što bih naučio osnovne riječi tog jezika i prešao većinu lekcija ___ Duolingu
questions.e: lekcije na Duolingu — lessons on Duolingo («na» + locative).

questions.q: Koristeći Duolingo, nakon samo šest do osam mjeseci stekao sam dovoljan ___
questions.e: dovoljan + masculine nominative/accusative: dovoljan vokabular.

questions.q: Dok sam učio španski i portugalski, imao sam u svom telefonu preko 300-400 ___
questions.e: After preko + numeral — genitive plural: pjesama.

questions.q: Čitajte novine iz te ___ čak i ako ne razumijete nijednu riječ
questions.e: iz + genitive: iz te zemlje — from that country.

questions.q: Nikada niko neće reći kako si loše ___ neki jezik
questions.e: The result of learning — a perfective verb: naučio.

questions.q: Zamislite sebe u poziciji da vam ___ neko ko uči naš jezik
questions.e: After «da» — perfective present: da vam dođe.
